ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-mid intensity distribution; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 4:1 against mid-intensity (light grey) interior regions. High-intensity white pixels are restricted to peripheral tips and water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity bands follow the entire trailing edge and central midline. Two large, roughly elliptical mid-intensity regions are positioned centrally on both the left and right lobes. No discrete high-contrast mottling or focal spots are detected within the fluke interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression at the center-point. The angle is approximately 125 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations observed across the entire linear boundary. Peaks are irregular, with some reaching pixel depths of ~10-15 units, creating a jagged, non-linear edge profile isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature originating from the notch and sweeping upwards and outwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity (white) circular pixel groups are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, likely representing site-specific scarring or surface accumulation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable high-contrast white spotting localized on the outer margins of the distal tips. The trailing edge exhibits significant irregular indentations consistent with cumulative physical wear.
